description_en: Retrieves the connection information for a MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 查询MongoDB分片集群实例的连接信息
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-sharding-network-address --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id d-bpxxxxxxxx --network-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeShardingNetworkAddress

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a mongos, shard, or ConfigServer node in the sharded cluster instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the IDs of mongos, shard, and ConfigServer nodes
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID、Shard节点ID或ConfigServer节点ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询Mongos/Shard/ConfigServer节点ID
parameters.name: node_id
